title: BIG PS1 Emulation News! Arcade Duck Major Updates
summary: Video Game Esoterica covers major updates to Arcade Duck, a DuckStation fork for PS1 arcade hardware including Namco System 10, System 12, and Capcom ZN-2.

blocks.text: The video discusses Arcade Duck, a specialized fork of the DuckStation PlayStation 1 emulator that focuses on arcade hardware based on PS1 architecture. According to the description, recent updates add support for Namco System 10, Namco System 12, and Capcom ZN-2 game libraries. The project aims to provide enhanced emulation for these specific arcade platforms, which differ from standard consumer PS1 titles in hardware configuration and game software.

Players interested in PS1-based arcade systems may benefit from a dedicated emulator branch targeting that hardware. Results will vary depending on host device performance and configuration settings. Claims about compatibility and quality reflect the creator's own assessment and have not been independently verified by this Hub. Users should only run software with legally obtained BIOS files and game images they own.
